_comment: Zenodo metadata for the MC2 colour images. Review before running `mc2_zenodo.py upload`; it can still be edited on zenodo.org until you publish. Empty creator fields are dropped.
title: Merging Cluster Collaboration (MC2): optical colour images and WCS headers of merging galaxy clusters
description:
Optical colour images of merging galaxy clusters from the Merging Cluster Collaboration (MC2) weak-lensing program, with a WCS header for each image.

Each cluster has two files:

  • <cluster>_color.jpg: colour image
  • <cluster>.head: FITS header text giving the WCS (RA---TAN / DEC--TAN, ICRS) for the JPG's pixel grid

The images can be browsed at kylefinner.github.io/mc2_viewer.html.
